gloss: inside story; behind the scenes; hidden circumstances

definitions.gloss: inside story; behind the scenes; hidden truth; inner workings
definitions.explanation: The hidden truth or real situation behind something that is not publicly known. What goes on behind closed doors.

examples.japanese: ⟦{政界|せいかい}→政界：15196_seikai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{内幕|うちまく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{暴|あば}く→暴く：04607_abaku⟧。
examples.english: To expose the inner workings of the political world.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{内幕|うちまく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{知|し}っている→知る：00458_shiru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧。
examples.english: Few people know what goes on behind the scenes at the company.

examples.japanese: {元社員|もとしゃいん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{書|か}いた→書く：00477_kaku⟧{本|ほん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{業界|ぎょうかい}→業界：13129_gyoukai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{知|し}られざる→知る：00458_shiru⟧{内幕|うちまく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{赤裸々|せきらら}→赤裸々：17380_sekirara⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{描|えが}かれていた→描く：02013_egaku⟧。
examples.english: The book written by a former employee candidly depicted the unknown inner workings of the industry.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{内|うち}→内：01328_uchi⟧ (inside) + ⟦{幕|まく}→幕：12518_maku⟧ (curtain). Literally 'the curtain inside'—what is hidden behind the curtain. Refers to the real, often unsavory truth behind public appearances.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {内幕|うちまく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{暴|あば}く→暴く：04607_abaku⟧: to expose the inside story
- {内幕|うちまく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{明|あ}かす→明かす：12961_akasu⟧: to reveal the inside story
- {内幕|うちまく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{知|し}る→知る：00458_shiru⟧: to know the inside story
- ⟦{政界|せいかい}→政界：15196_seikai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{内幕|うちまく}: the inner workings of politics
- {内幕|うちまく}もの: behind-the-scenes story (genre)

PRONUNCIATION:
Also read as ⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧まく, which has the same meaning but a slightly more formal feel.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{裏側|うらがわ}→裏側：03042_uragawa⟧: the other side — more casual; {内幕|うちまく} implies hidden, potentially scandalous information
- ⟦{舞台裏|ぶたいうら}→舞台裏：08377_butaiura⟧: backstage — can be literal or figurative; {内幕|うちまく} is always figurative and focuses on hidden truths
- ⟦{実態|じったい}→実態：10567_jittai⟧: actual conditions — neutral term for the real state of affairs; {内幕|うちまく} implies something deliberately hidden
